verses.original: וַתִּקְרַ֜בְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֗ד בֶּן־ חֵ֤פֶר בֶּן־ גִּלְעָד֙ בֶּן־ מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן־ יוֹסֵ֑ף וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֹתָ֔יו מַחְלָ֣ה נֹעָ֔ה וְחָגְלָ֥ה וּמִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·raḇ·nāh bə·nō·wṯ ṣə·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ ben- ḥê·p̄er ben- gil·‘āḏ ben- mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh lə·miš·pə·ḥōṯ mə·naš·šeh ḇen- yō·w·sêp̄ wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nō·ṯāw maḥ·lāh nō·‘āh wə·ḥā·ḡə·lāh ū·mil·kāh wə·ṯir·ṣāh
verses.literal: Now the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher the son of Gilead the son of Machir the son of Manasseh belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph These were the names of his daughters Mahlah Noah Hoglah Milcah and Tirzah They approached
verses.literalPt: Então, vieram as filhas de Zelofeade, filho de Hefer, filho de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés, das famílias de Manassés, filho de José; e estes são os nomes de suas filhas: Maalá, Noa, Hogla, Milca e Tirza.

verses.original: וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֜דְנָה לִפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְלִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הַנְּשִׂיאִ֖ם וְכָל־ הָעֵדָ֑ה פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘ă·mō·ḏə·nāh lip̄·nê mō·šeh wə·lip̄·nê ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·lip̄·nê han·nə·śî·’im wə·ḵāl hā·‘ê·ḏāh pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ lê·mōr
verses.literal: the entrance to the Tent of Meeting stood before Moses . . . Eleazar the priest . . . the leaders and the whole congregation and said
verses.literalPt: Apresentaram-se diante de Moisés, e diante do sacerdote Eleazar, e diante dos príncipes e toda a congregação, à entrada da tenda da revelação, e disseram:

verses.original: אָבִינוּ֮ מֵ֣ת בַּמִּדְבָּר֒ וְה֨וּא לֹא־ הָיָ֜ה בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעֵדָ֗ה הַנּוֹעָדִ֛ים עַל־ יְהוָ֖ה בַּעֲדַת־ קֹ֑רַח כִּֽי־ בְחֶטְא֣וֹ מֵ֔ת וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־ הָ֥יוּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇî·nū mêṯ bam·miḏ·bār wə·hū lō- hā·yāh bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘ê·ḏāh han·nō·w·‘ā·ḏîm ‘al- Yah·weh ba·‘ă·ḏaṯ- qō·raḥ kî- ḇə·ḥeṭ·’ōw mêṯ ū·ḇā·nîm lō- hā·yū lōw
verses.literal: Our father died in the wilderness but he was not among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD . . . Instead he died because of his own sin and he had no sons
verses.literalPt: Nosso pai morreu no deserto, e não se achou entre a companhia daqueles que se reuniram contra Jeová na companhia de Coré; porém morreu no seu próprio pecado; e não tinha filhos.

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה יִגָּרַ֤ע שֵׁם־ אָבִ֙ינוּ֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֔וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ בֵּ֑ן תְּנָה־ לָּ֣נוּ אֲחֻזָּ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֥י אָבִֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh yig·gā·ra‘ šêm- ’ā·ḇî·nū mit·tō·wḵ miš·paḥ·tōw kî ’ên lōw bên tə·nāh- lā·nū ’ă·ḥuz·zāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ă·ḥê ’ā·ḇî·nū
verses.literal: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan because he had no sons Give us property among our father’s brothers
verses.literalPt: Por que se tirará o nome de nosso pai dentre a sua família, porquanto não tinha filhos? Dai-nos possessão entre os irmãos de nosso pai.

verses.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֥ב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטָ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·rêḇ mō·šeh ’eṯ- miš·på̄·ṭå̄n lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Moses brought their case before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Moisés levou a causa delas perante Jeová .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: and the LORD . . . answered him . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָד֮ דֹּבְרֹת֒ נָתֹ֨ן תִּתֵּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֣י אֲבִיהֶ֑ם וְהַֽעֲבַרְתָּ֛ אֶת־ נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבִיהֶ֖ן לָהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kên bə·nō·wṯ ṣə·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ dō·ḇə·rōṯ nā·ṯōn tit·tên lā·hem ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ na·ḥă·lāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ă·ḥê ’ă·ḇî·hem wə·ha·‘ă·ḇar·tā ’eṯ- na·ḥă·laṯ ’ă·ḇî·hen lā·hen
verses.literal: The daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly You certainly must give . . . them property as an inheritance among their father’s brothers and transfer their father’s inheritance to them
verses.literalPt: As filhas de Zelofeade falam o que é justo; certamente, lhes darás possessão de herança entre os irmãos de seu pai; e farás passar a elas a herança de seu pai.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ כִּֽי־ יָמ֗וּת וּבֵן֙ אֵ֣ין ל֔וֹ וְהַֽעֲבַרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לְבִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl tə·ḏab·bêr lê·mōr ’îš kî- yā·mūṯ ū·ḇên ’ên lōw wə·ha·‘ă·ḇar·tem ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw lə·ḇit·tōw
verses.literal: Furthermore you shall say . . . to the Israelites . . . If a man dies and leaves no son you are to transfer his inheritance to his daughter
verses.literalPt: Dirás aos filhos de Israel: Se morrer um homem e não tiver filhos, fareis passar a sua herança à sua filha.

verses.original: וְאִם־ אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ בַּ֑ת וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לְאֶחָיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ên lōw baṯ ū·nə·ṯat·tem ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw lə·ʾɛ·ḥå̄w
verses.literal: If he has no daughter give his inheritance to his brothers
verses.literalPt: Se não tiver filha, dareis a sua herança aos seus irmãos.

verses.original: וְאִם־ אֵ֥ין ל֖וֹ אַחִ֑ים וּנְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לַאֲחֵ֥י אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ên lōw ’a·ḥîm ū·nə·ṯat·tem ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw la·’ă·ḥê ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: If he has no brothers give his inheritance to his father’s brothers
verses.literalPt: Se não tiver irmãos, dareis a sua herança aos irmãos de seu pai.

verses.original: וְאִם־ אֵ֣ין אַחִים֮ לְאָבִיו֒ וּנְתַתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לִשְׁאֵר֞וֹ הַקָּרֹ֥ב אֵלָ֛יו מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖וֹ וְיָרַ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑הּ וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה לִבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְחֻקַּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֔ט כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ên ’a·ḥîm lə·’ā·ḇîw ū·nə·ṯat·tem ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw liš·’ê·rōw haq·qā·rōḇ ’ê·lāw mim·miš·paḥ·tōw wə·yā·raš ’ō·ṯāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḥuq·qaṯ miš·pāṭ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: And if his father has no brothers give his inheritance to the next . . . of kin from his clan that he may take possession of it This is to be a statutory ordinance for the Israelites . . . as the LORD has commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Se seu pai não tiver irmãos, dareis a sua herança ao seu parente que lhe é mais chegado de sua família, e este a possuirá; isso será para os filhos de Israel uma prescrição de direito, como Jeová ordenou a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה עֲלֵ֛ה אֶל־ הַ֥ר הָעֲבָרִ֖ים הַזֶּ֑ה וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh ‘ă·lêh ’el- har hā·‘ă·ḇā·rîm haz·zeh ū·rə·’êh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Go up . . . this mountain of the Abarim range and see the land that I have given the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Sobe a este monte Abarim e vê a terra que dei aos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וְרָאִ֣יתָה אֹתָ֔הּ וְנֶאֱסַפְתָּ֥ אֶל־ עַמֶּ֖יךָ גַּם־ אָ֑תָּה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱסַ֖ף אַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’î·ṯāh ’ō·ṯāh wə·ne·’ĕ·sap̄·tā ’el- ‘am·me·ḵā gam- ’āt·tāh ka·’ă·šer ne·’ĕ·sap̄ ’a·hă·rōn ’ā·ḥî·ḵā
verses.literal: After you have seen it you too will be gathered to your people as your brother Aaron was
verses.literalPt: Tendo-a visto, serás também recolhido ao teu povo, assim como o foi teu irmão Arão;

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ מְרִיתֶ֨ם פִּ֜י בְּמִדְבַּר־ צִ֗ן בִּמְרִיבַת֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה לְהַקְדִּישֵׁ֥נִי בַמַּ֖יִם לְעֵינֵיהֶ֑ם הֵ֛ם מֵֽי־ מְרִיבַ֥ת קָדֵ֖שׁ מִדְבַּר־ צִֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer mə·rî·ṯem pî bə·miḏ·bar- ṣin bim·rî·ḇaṯ hā·‘ê·ḏāh lə·haq·dî·šê·nî ḇam·ma·yim lə·‘ê·nê·hem hêm mê- mə·rî·ḇaṯ qā·ḏêš miḏ·bar- ṣin
verses.literal: for when the congregation contended in the Wilderness of Zin both of you rebelled against My command to show My holiness in their sight regarding the waters Those were the waters of Meribah in Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin
verses.literalPt: porque, no deserto de Zim, na contenda da congregação, fostes rebeldes à minha ordem, não me santificando diante dos seus olhos na questão das águas (Estas são as águas de Meribá de Cades, no deserto de Zim.).

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh ’el- Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: So Moses appealed to the LORD . . .
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Moisés a Jeová:

verses.original: יִפְקֹ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָרוּחֹ֖ת לְכָל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר אִ֖ישׁ עַל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yip̄·qōḏ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·rū·ḥōṯ lə·ḵāl bā·śār ’îš ‘al- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: May the LORD the God of the spirits of all flesh appoint a man over the congregation
verses.literalPt: Que Jeová, Deus dos espíritos de toda a carne, ponha um homem sobre a congregação,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ יֵצֵ֣א לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יָבֹא֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹצִיאֵ֖ם וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְבִיאֵ֑ם וְלֹ֤א תִהְיֶה֙ עֲדַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כַּצֹּ֕אן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין־ לָהֶ֖ם רֹעֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- yê·ṣê lip̄·nê·hem wa·’ă·šer yā·ḇō lip̄·nê·hem wa·’ă·šer yō·w·ṣî·’êm wa·’ă·šer yə·ḇî·’êm wə·lō ṯih·yeh ‘ă·ḏaṯ Yah·weh kaṣ·ṣōn ’ă·šer ’ên- lā·hem rō·‘eh
verses.literal: who will go out and come in before them and who will lead them out and bring them in so that the congregation of the LORD will not be like sheep without a shepherd
verses.literalPt: o qual saia adiante deles, e entre adiante deles, e os faça sair, e os faça entrar; para que a congregação de Jeová não seja como ovelhas que não têm pastor.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַח־ לְךָ֙ אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֔וּן אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ ר֣וּחַ בּ֑וֹ וְסָמַכְתָּ֥ אֶת־ יָדְךָ֖ עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh qaḥ- lə·ḵā ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn ’îš ’ă·šer- rū·aḥ bōw wə·sā·maḵ·tā ’eṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: And the LORD replied to Moses Take Joshua son of Nun a man with the Spirit in him and lay your hands on him
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Toma a Josué, filho de Num, varão no qual reside o Espírito, e impõe-lhe a mão;

verses.original: וְהַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֗וֹ לִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֑ה וְצִוִּיתָ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·‘ă·maḏ·tā ’ō·ṯōw lip̄·nê ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·lip̄·nê kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh wə·ṣiw·wî·ṯāh ’ō·ṯōw lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest . . . and the whole congregation and commission him in their sight
verses.literalPt: apresenta-o diante do sacerdote Eleazar e diante de toda a congregação; e, diante deles, dá-lhe a comissão.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֥ה מֵהֽוֹדְךָ֖ עָלָ֑יו לְמַ֣עַן יִשְׁמְע֔וּ כָּל־ עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh mê·hō·wḏ·ḵā ‘ā·lāw lə·ma·‘an yiš·mə·‘ū kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Confer on him some of your authority so that the whole congregation . . . of Israel will obey him
verses.literalPt: Sobre eles porás uma parte da tua majestade, para que lhe obedeça toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וְלִפְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְשָׁ֥אַל ל֛וֹ בְּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט הָאוּרִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ פִּ֨יו יֵצְא֜וּ וְעַל־ פִּ֣יו יָבֹ֗אוּ ה֛וּא וְכָל־ בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אִתּ֖וֹ וְכָל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lip̄·nê ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên ya·‘ă·mōḏ wə·šā·’al lōw bə·miš·paṭ hā·’ū·rîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘al- pîw yê·ṣə·’ū wə·‘al- pîw yā·ḇō·’ū hū wə·ḵāl bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’it·tōw wə·ḵāl hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest who will seek counsel for him before the LORD by the judgment of the Urim At his command . . . he and all the Israelites . . . with him the entire congregation will go out . . . . . . and come in
verses.literalPt: Apresentar-se-á perante o sacerdote Eleazar, o qual a respeito dele indagará segundo o juízo do Urim, diante de Jeová; à ordem de Eleazar, sairão; e, à ordem de Eleazar, entrarão, ele e todos os filhos de Israel, isto é, toda a congregação.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַיַּֽעֲמִדֵ֙הוּ֙ לִפְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלִפְנֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś mō·šeh ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·ya·‘ă·mi·ḏê·hū lip̄·nê ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·lip̄·nê kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: Moses did as the LORD had commanded him He took Joshua had him stand before Eleazar the priest . . . and the whole congregation
verses.literalPt: Fez Moisés como Jeová lhe ordenou; e, tendo tomado a Josué, apresentou-o diante do sacerdote Eleazar e diante de toda a congregação;

verses.original: וַיִּסְמֹ֧ךְ אֶת־ יָדָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו וַיְצַוֵּ֑הוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yis·mōḵ ’eṯ- yā·ḏāw ‘ā·lāw way·ṣaw·wê·hū ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: and laid his hands on him and commissioned him as the LORD had instructed through Moses
verses.literalPt: impôs-lhe as mãos e deu-lhe a comissão, como Jeová falou por intermédio de Moisés.
